faq.heading: A few things you may want to ask us:

items.question: What happens after I submit an enquiry?
items.title: Process
items.description: We review your goals, timeline, budget and business context before deciding whether the project is a good fit. You will receive a response outlining the most practical next step.

links.description: A short discovery conversation is normally used to clarify the commercial problem and required outcomes.
When the scope is clear, we provide a proposal covering deliverables, timing, responsibilities and fees.

items.question: Which industries do you work with?
items.title: Industries
items.description: GT Marketing works with Australian businesses across healthcare, NDIS, hospitality, professional services, property, technology and other growth-focused sectors.

links.description: Regulated sectors require careful attention to claims, privacy, participant or patient trust and advertising obligations.

items.question: Can you manage strategy and execution together?
items.title: Delivery
items.description: Yes. Our model is designed to connect positioning, campaign planning, content, websites, paid media, automation and reporting rather than treating them as unrelated tasks.

links.description: The exact delivery team and channel mix depend on your priorities, internal capability and available budget.

items.question: Do you work with other agencies and specialists?
items.title: Collaboration
items.description: Yes. We collaborate with photographers, videographers, developers, designers and specialist advisers when that produces a stronger result for the client.

links.description: Responsibilities and ownership are clarified before delivery so you have one accountable point of contact.

items.question: Can you support workshops or speaking engagements?
items.title: Training
items.description: GT Marketing can support practical workshops and presentations covering marketing strategy, digital execution, AI-enabled workflows, brand positioning and communication.

links.description: Send the audience, topic, location and expected format through the contact form so we can assess the request.
